The earlier `tenacity` refactor is superseded and stopped until next sprint. Do not edit `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`. ## Recent work: Optimized search rebuilding by tenant-scoping invoice queries, batching embeddings in chunks of 100 with bounded concurrency, sharing the embedding client through the management command, and bulk-upserting vectors in one transaction. Performance improved from roughly 16.73s median to 2.41s median for 10,000 documents. Added a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index migration at `ledgerly/db/migrations/0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`; full tests passed with 247 passed and 4 skipped. Search-specific suites also passed.

The Kubernetes schema job completed successfully. A canary deployment was created using `2.8.0-rc.2`, though rollout status was not recorded.

Keep commits small for review. A separate CSV export test currently fails because a test incorrectly decodes UTF-8 bytes; this is not the current objective. For new Sentry issues, prefix titles with `[billing]` and use fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

## Current objective: Replace the hand-rolled retry loop in `ledgerly/sync/client.py` with `tenacity`. A separate operator-requested “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” should be run between other work; no rollout steps are recorded as executed yet. Do not edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`.

## Recent work: Worker memory repro at 5,000 batches stayed at 7.3 MiB peak and settled to 2.1 MiB; the full suite previously passed (118 passed, 7 skipped). CLI billing filters were consolidated with `_add_billing_filters()`. Fixed the explicit `dest="currency"`, removed a duplicate invoice-list currency option, updated an obsolete command-layer assertion from `args.filters["currency"]` to `args.currency`, and added a regression test for `--curr`/`--sta` abbreviations. Combined CLI/command tests pass (37 passed), Ruff passes, `git diff --check` passes, abbreviation parsing was manually verified, and help now shows one `--currency/-c` entry.

## Current objective: Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The earlier `tenacity` refactor was explicitly stopped until next sprint. Do not edit `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`.

## Recent work: Webhook retry handling was completed in `ledgerly/webhooks.py`: bounded exponential backoff for transport errors and retryable 5xx responses, immediate propagation of 4xx errors, and re-raising after exhaustion. Tests cover successful retry, retry exhaustion, server errors, and non-retryable client errors. `pytest -q tests/test_webhooks.py` passed 8 tests; full suite passed 44 tests; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

The requested Kubernetes rollout had progressed: production resources were inspected, image `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3` was built and pushed successfully, and job `api-2-8-0-schema` was created in `prod-us-east-1`/`payments` to run `/app/migrate up`; completion was not recorded.

A focused search-index baseline was run: 18 passed and 2 failed because rebuilt documents missed recently updated invoice descriptions. That indexing work was not the current operator priority.

For all new Sentry issues, prefix titles with `[billing]` and use fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.
